page.layout: One printed page with running text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin beside lines 4 to 7; running head at top; page number top left; catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: id,de quo nobifcum amicus conqueritur: vel in rem,aut persona aliam culpa transfertur: vel illud ipsum,vt recte,iuste,honeste factum,defenditur:vel ad confesio-nem nudam atq; venię deprecatione confugitur. Argumēta in respōden-do ad aliorū querelas ob seruanda.Itaq; ex iisdem erunt locis argumenta hic sumeda, quos adhibendos esse monuimus in responsionibus ad aliorum expostulationes institutis:ita quidē,vt in negatione simplici causæ impellentes ac finales: in adiunctis circumstantiæ rerum, personarum,locorum,temporum considerentur:in defensione legitima adhibeantur; causæ,testimonia,exempla etiā eorū, qui idē,sine tñ querela aut reprehensione vlla fecerint: in μέμψει[?] culpa transferatur in ipsum q de nobis queritur, aut personas alias, aut necessitate, fortuna aduersam, ignorantia,imprudentia,locū,etiā tēpus, & his similes circumstantias alias: in deprecatione confugiatur ad ingenuā confesionē,pœnitentiā,delicti conditionem, hominū imbecillitate, cōmendatione cū nostrā,tū eius ad quē scribimus: exempla deniq; illorum, qui similibus vel etiā graviorib.in delictis sint veniā consecuti. Nō dissimilis quoq; hīc animorū, cūm conciliandorū,tùm mouedorū instituēda ratio erit.

page.notes: The Greek word at "μέμψει" is set in italic and is not fully certain; marked [?]. The catchword "erit." is at the lower right. The note's line-end hyphen "respōden-" is printed. The word "conciliandorū" is split across the line end without a printed hyphen and is written whole. The reading "confesio-nem" is as printed.
